scope: One named public skill and its existing public project test-fixture exports. Ten planned paired trials extend the fixed 719-source cohort; this subset is not representative full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: Authorize only the ten missing pairs for this frozen reviewed source. The full 719-source launch remains gated. Freeze each reviewed task before its model calls; retain all attempts and do not choose tasks from observed model results. This source was selected because its own pinned repository provides complete public inputs and a benign independently checkable task. No historical outcomes or predicted labels were used.

runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

cases.task_request: Read /inputs/mewt-results.json and /inputs/mewt-status.txt and inventory the completed mutation campaign. Use only these existing exports; do not install tools, rerun a campaign, or modify inputs. Write /work/mutation-summary.json as a JSON object with exactly these fields: campaign (integer fields total, tested, caught, uncaught, timeout, skipped from the Campaign-Wide Summary); exported_uncaught_ids (all exported mutant IDs, sorted numerically); exported_uncaught_by_target (target path to sorted mutant-ID list); kill_rate (integer numerator=caught, denominator=caught+uncaught, without reduction); and equivalence (the string not_assessed). Use campaign-wide totals, not the number of records in the filtered uncaught export. Do not count skipped or timed-out mutations as caught and do not infer semantic equivalence from survival. This request covers the quantitative inventory stage, not a full equivalence or vulnerability assessment. Check the saved JSON against the exports. An inline answer is not the deliverable.
public_input_search: Reviewed the original skill routing and result-interpretation sections.
Selected complete existing campaign exports from the same pinned repository, without creating substitute input data.
cases.verifier_policy: Reference values are computed only in the trusted parent from both frozen exports. No verifier internals or reference answer enter compiler/executor prompts or the container.
cases.fixture_validation: 79 sandboxed tests passed, including one opt-in actual local container control checking read-only inputs, JSON snapshotting, and accepted/rejected goal artifacts. Handwritten controls are setup evidence, not LLM executions.

eligibility: New measurements must reconcile actual tool traces, goal-verification receipts, native exact-model subscription usage and all interruptions. No population extrapolation.
storage_policy: Only this bounded named-source extension is authorized. Stop before a new stage below the one-billion-byte shared-volume reserve. Never overwrite or rerun a retained incomplete stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: The isolated fixture controls use no models. Existing valid guarded text receipts are reused, avoiding extra paid availability probes; each new stage still rejects unreported or unexpected serving identity and tools.
